prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: Transparent cutout photographic hanging event festoon bulb, OFF state for a matched UI crossfade pair.
Primary request: Exactly one realistic Edison S14 / E27 string-light bulb hanging vertically. A compact dark charcoal with subtle oxblood tint weatherproof socket at the top center holds one clear slightly warm pear-shaped glass bulb. The fine unlit tungsten filament support structure is visible through the clear glass. The light is OFF.
Scene/backdrop: Genuine transparent alpha background. No ground, environment, extra wire or cord.
Composition/framing: Portrait canvas approximately 1024x1536. Perfectly centered vertical product silhouette. The socket cap starts at about 8 percent from the top and its attachment anchor is exactly in the horizontal center. The complete socket and glass fit comfortably within frame. The full object occupies about 80 percent of frame height, with transparent margin on every side. No tilt. Camera straight-on, product photography. The glass must read cleanly at a final 40–50px wide by about80px high display.
Lighting/mood: Neutral soft studio lighting, understated warm event terrace material character, realistic reflections on transparent glass. No illuminated glow at all.
Materials/textures: Matte ridged weatherproof charcoal socket, slight wine-colored reflections, clear thin glass wall, fine metallic filament and support wires. Transparent glass must remain legible over both ivory paper and a dark wine background.
Text: none.
Constraints: ONE bulb only. Photorealistic dimensional product shot. Real transparent alpha with subtle glass transparency and crisp clean edges. No extra wire, background, ground, hand, text, logo or watermark.
Avoid: illustration, cartoon, flat icon, Christmas ornament, multiple bulbs, blue glass, glowing filament, neon halo, dark rectangular backdrop, white matte fringe, cropped socket.
